spells.notes: Start is the 임명장 day. With no gazette file before 2001, the legal appointment date is read from the day the 임명장 was handed over. From 2001 the 관보 dates appointments announced one day before the 임명장 on the 임명장 day. Examples in the main rosters are 이헌재 2004-02-11, 김승규 2004-07-29 and 오명 2003-12-29, where the 임명장 day is reported, and 곽결호 2004-02-18 and 이재용 2005-06-29, one day after the announcement. Named on 1993-12-21 (12·21 개각) on the recommendation of PM 이회창 (한겨레 1993-12-22 profile '이총리 추천케이스', News Library 1993122200289104012, and 서울신문 1993-12-22 '총무처·환경처 이 총리 제청 수용', BigKinds 01100611.20160422071316882), 임명장 at 09:00 on 1993-12-22. Former 법제처 차장 and 경희대 교수 of administrative law. 환경처 ceased to exist at the end of 1994-12-22, when 환경부와그소속기관직제 took effect on 1994-12-23 and with it 법률 제4831호 제26조 삭제 and 제38조의2. He still held press conferences as 환경처장관 on 1994-12-21. The continuation as 환경부장관 on 1994-12-23..24 is the next spell. The ministry list ends him on 1994-12-21 and starts 김중위 that day, which the 1994-12-21/22 press contradicts. No exact birth date was found. He has no ko.wikipedia or Wikidata entry and the 1993 profiles give no age. Later papers give his age as 56 in July 1991 (경향신문 1991-07-30 p.9 '경찰위원 약력', News Library 1991073000329109017, text '朴鈗炘▲全南 寶城출생·56세', which also gives his birthplace), 59 in January 1994 (조선일보 1994-01-17 p.31, News Library 1994011700239131010, text '朴鈗炘환경처장관(59)') and 61 or 60 in February 1996 (조선일보 1996-02-08 p.46, News Library 1996020800239146016, text '朴鈗炘전환경부장관(61)', 세계일보 BigKinds 01100701.19960208000003005 '(61)', 경향신문 BigKinds 01100101.19960208000002207 '(60)' and 한국일보 BigKinds 01101101.19960208000003704 '(60)'). Depending on how each paper counted age, this puts his birth between 1934 and 1936, so birth_date stays null. Snapshots are in roster/sources/environment/ext88/birth/ (accessed 2026-09-26T12:47:44-0400 to 12:48:14-0400). Gender from the 1993-12-22 profiles, which name his wife.

From 2001 the 관보 dates appointments announced one day before the 임명장 on the 임명장 day. spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee still in office on 1998-02-25 (caretaker holdover until the first 김대중 cabinet of 1998-03-03). Start date is outside the window and rests on the ministry list and Wikipedia only (no digital gazette before 2001). Hanja 尹汝儁 from the NA member file (Wikipedia prints 尹汝雋). Birth date from the NA member file and ko.wikipedia person page https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42274560 (출생일 1939-10-17, snapshot roster/sources/environment/wiki_people/wiki_윤여준.json, accessed 2026-09-25T13:37:46-0400, secondary). [verifier] Start is disputed. Six dailies of 1997-08-06 (동아일보, 경향신문, 매일경제, 한겨레, 세계일보, 서울경제) report that 김영삼 carried out the 8·5 개각 and appointed the new ministers on 1997-08-05, while the 임명장 were handed over at 09:30 on 1997-08-06 (연합뉴스). The ministry list and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-06. The value is kept, as in most sibling rosters for the same reshuffle (justice uses 1997-08-05). The start lies before the window and does not affect any in-window day. End confirmed by 1998-03-03 reports of the first 김대중 cabinet and by the 법제처 reading that sitting ministers stay until successors are appointed (한겨레 1998-02-27).

issues.desc: Start-date rule for 1988-2000. There is no gazette file, so each start is the 임명장 day. Five spells in this file were announced one day before the 임명장 (권이혁 1991-04-25/26, 이재창 1992-06-25/26, 박윤흔 1993-12-21/22, 김중위 1994-12-23/24, 정종택 1995-12-20/21), and the from_main 윤여준 spell follows the same rule (1997-08-05/06). From 2001 the 관보 dates such appointments one day after the announcement, on the 임명장 day where that is reported (main rosters, for example 이헌재 and 김승규 in 2004 and 오명 in 2003, and also 곽결호 2004 and 이재용 2005). The ministry list agrees with the 임명장 day in every case except 김중위. Sibling ext88 files should use the same rule. The main justice roster uses 1997-08-05 for the 8·5 개각, the announcement day.

The ministry list (mcee.go.kr menuId=366) and ko.wikipedia start 김중위 on 1994-12-21 and end 박윤흔 on 1994-12-21. The 12·23 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 and the 임명장 given on the morning of 1994-12-24 (국민일보 1994-12-24, 매일경제 1994-12-25, 한국일보 1994-12-25), and 박윤흔 still held a press conference as 환경처장관 on 1994-12-21 (조선일보, 서울경제 1994-12-22). The 법무부 list prints 1994.12.24 for 안우만 from the same reshuffle. This file uses 1994-12-24 for 김중위.

1994-12-23 changeover. 법률 제4831호 부칙 제2조① deems 환경처 officials to be 환경부 officials without excluding 정무직. The same sentence excludes 정무직 for the merged ministries (경제기획원·재무부 → 재정경제원, 건설부·교통부 → 건설교통부), and gives no exclusion for 상공자원부 → 통상산업부, 체신부 → 정보통신부 and 보건사회부 → 보건복지부. This file therefore adds a reorg_continuation spell for 박윤흔 as 환경부장관 on 1994-12-23..24. The alternative is a one-day vacancy on 1994-12-23 with 차관 김형철 as the presumed acting head. The press calls 김중위 the first 환경부장관, and no story names 박윤흔 as 환경부장관. The ict, industry and health ext88 files meet the same clause and should be harmonized with this choice. The health case is informative. 국민일보 1994-12-24 says 서상목 was retained as 보건복지부장관 under the new name ('명칭이 변경된 보건복지부장관에 유임됐다').

허남훈 end and 권이혁 start. 경향신문 1991-04-26 says 노태우 dismissed 허남훈 on 1991-04-25 and that the successors were '임명,발령' that day. The 임명장 was given on the morning of 1991-04-26, and 허남훈's 이임식 was at 09:00 on 1991-04-26. The file uses 1991-04-26 for both. If the 25th is the legal date, 허남훈 ends and 권이혁 starts on 1991-04-25.

황산성 end. She gave farewell remarks on the afternoon of 1993-12-21 (동아일보 1993-12-22). The file ends her spell that day, while the ministry list and ko.wikipedia give 1993-12-22, the successor's 임명장 day. The main rosters follow a documented farewell when there is one (for example 곽결호 2005-06-28).

Office title. The ko.wikipedia list claims the head was '환경처 처장' under 노태우 and '환경처 장관' only from 1993. 법률 제4183호 제26조의2② establishes a 장관 and the press of 1989-1992 writes 환경처장관 throughout (for example 동아일보 1989-12-28, 서울신문 1991-04-27). The file uses 환경처장관 for every 환경처 spell.

박윤흔 has no ko.wikipedia or Wikidata entry and no exact birth date in a saved source. Reported ages (56 in 1991-07, 59 in 1994-01, 60 or 61 in 1996-02) put his birth between 1934 and 1936, see the spell notes. Gender is from the 1993-12-22 profiles (서울신문, 세계일보), which name his wife. 조경식, 권이혁 and 황산성 birth dates rest on ko.wikipedia and Wikidata only (secondary). For 권이혁 Wikidata has only the year.
조경식's move to 농림수산부 on 1990-09-19 belongs to the agriculture lineage, where his spell should start on the same day as the end here (임명장 on the morning of 1990-09-19).

Person linking. 권이혁 is written 權彛赫 here (ko.wikipedia, 조선일보 1991), while 경향신문 1991 prints 權彜赫 and 權彝赫, variant forms of one character. build_panel.py compares hanja as plain strings, so a health ext88 spell (보건사회부장관 before 1990) written with another variant links only through the birth date 1923-07-13.

structural_gap.why: No 국무위원 office in the lineage. 환경청 (보건사회부장관 소속, 청장 정무직) was not a 국무위원 post (offices_1988.json lineage_gaps). Its heads 박판제, 이상배 and 이재창 are out of scope.

continuity.handover_rule: Same-day handovers end the predecessor on the successor's start date. Where a farewell on the previous day is documented (황산성, and 김중위 after the verifier's correction) the predecessor ends that day and no day is uncovered.
